_comment: Openable doors R1 (designer 2026-11-21: generated buildings need doors that can be OPENED; door spec 2026-11-22; roadmap docs/port/ROADMAP_THREE_TRACKS_2026-11-21.md: doors change sight / cover / paths, so they sit BEHIND A SWITCH, OFF BY DEFAULT - turning it on in main needs the enemy-AI A/B). Read by DoorTuning (C++, Source/CodexTactics/Public/Interactables/DoorRules.h). With the switch on every builder leaf tagged door_state=closed|locked (build_levelgen_map.py opening_state_specs) becomes an ADoorActor: closed (UNLOCKED) and locked leaves block sight, bullets and bodies; an unlocked door is priced on the navmesh (UNavArea_DoorClosed, nav_entering_cost_cm), a locked one blocked (NavArea_Null); open = nothing blocks. Barricaded / sealed doors stay the builder's blocking pieces. Console Codex.Doors.Openable -1 = this file's enabled (default), 0 = off, 1 = on (read every tick: switching adopts / releases the leaves). All numbers are the designer's to tune.
_comment_swing: open_s / close_s: the leaf's swing; swing_deg: how far round its hinge an open leaf stands; single_leaf_max_cm: wider doorways get two leaves (kit leaf sizes 80-130 cm single).
_comment_auto: Auto-open (AI, the squad, enemies, an operative's own walk): a pawn within zone_depth_cm of the leaf plane (zone_slack_cm past each jamb, at the door's level) whose navmesh path crosses the doorway within path_look_ahead_cm - or who walks into the leaf faster than heading_speed_cm_s - opens an UNLOCKED door after auto_open_delay_s. Locked doors never auto-open.
_comment_click: The player's click on a door (or on the floor within click_snap_cm of an open leaf): the leader walks to approach_cm in front of the leaf on his side and acts once his feet are within interact_reach_cm of the doorway centre. SINGLE click: an unlocked door opens BY HAND (hand_open_s with the hand_open_montage hook, then the swing); an open door shuts (refused while somebody stands in the doorway; never a blown-off one); a locked door opens with the squad's KEY (unlock_s, unlock_montage, then by hand) - without a key a line says how else. DOUBLE click: the KICK (below). Ctrl + click on a locked door: SHOOT THE LOCK (below). An order not done after interact_timeout_s is dropped.
_comment_key: Keys: a key id is a building id (every locked door of that building), an opening id (one door), a door's door_key=<id> tag, or * (all). start_keys: what the squad holds from the start. R2: keys are items - a loot container's KeyIds (FLootContents), a searched body (an enemy who carried one), a mission goal's grant_keys; console Codex.Doors.GiveKey <id> for testing.
_comment_nav: nav_entering_cost_cm: the navmesh price of an unlocked closed door (t_open 1 s x walk speed, opening-states.md F1; read at start-up, a change needs a restart); nav_box_depth_cm: depth of the doorway's nav modifier across the wall.
_comment_kick: KICK (double click; opening-states.md F1): every attempt takes kick_s (the kick_montage hook; its hit moment = kick_s) and makes the lure noise of kick_noise_m (N_kick 15 m: enemies in earshot investigate). One attempt opens an unlocked door with kick_chance_closed, a locked one with kick_chance_locked; a heavy door (tag door_heavy, or at least heavy_min_width_cm wide: the entrances) multiplies it by kick_heavy_factor. Up to kick_max_attempts per double click, then a line. Each attempt hurts him with kick_injury_base + kick_injury_wounded (his health below kick_wounded_below) + kick_injury_heavy (a heavy door): kick_injury_damage health. kick_enabled 0 = no kicks.
_comment_shot: SHOOT THE LOCK (Ctrl + click on a locked door): he walks to lock_shot_stand_cm on his side unless within lock_shot_range_cm with a clear line, fires a quick-fire burst at the lock (his weapon's own noise, ammo, cadence), and lock_shot_resolve_s later the lock breaks with lock_shot_chance of his weapon (weapons' WeaponId; default for the rest) - the door bursts open.
_comment_blast: BLOW IT: any explosion (grenade, RPG-7, mine, barrel) within its own radius and blast_reach_cm of the doorway centre breaks the leaf (gone, the doorway open for good) - locked doors too.
_comment_r2_clips: R2 door clips (designer 2026-11-22, the pack /Game/Free_Interaction_Animation/Animations/Door): open by hand = anim_OpenDoor_L/R, kick = anim_OpenDoor_Kick_L/R (the legs ALTERNATE between attempts, the first on the lock's side), push = anim_OpenDoor_Push_L/R (a door that WAS locked, opened after the key or a shot lock). L / R: the side of him the handle is on as he faces the leaf (a pair: where the leaves meet); montage_swap_lr 1 flips it. montages: skeleton name -> clip key -> montage (or anim sequence, played on the FullBody slot); 'default' serves the operatives whose skeleton is not listed (other pawns only their own skeleton's set). Made by Scripts/Editor/setup_door_animation.py into /Game/Animations/Door (untracked: derived from the untracked pack). montage_contact_s: seconds from the clip start to the hand / foot on the leaf - the leaf starts its swing (open / push) or the kick lands then (measured by the setup script); without a clip the hand_open_s / kick_s / push_s timings hold. A missing asset logs a warning and the timings hold.
_comment_r2_root_motion: Root motion (designer 2026-11-22, option a): the clips move the capsule (the pelvis travel baked into the root by setup_door_animation.py). montage_root_cm: the clip's root travel (operatives' copies; the PMC's are 74 / 105 / 196) - the smokes check the capsule's move against it. montage_approach_cm: he starts the clip this far in front of the leaf plane, square to it (its start pose): the root reaches the leaf at the contact (open 42, kick 21, push 188 cm of travel) and he ends at the doorway (open 14, push 26 cm in front of the plane; a kick that gives carries him through, one that holds stops at the leaf). He starts once within montage_approach_slack_cm of the start point.
_comment_r2_breach: R2 enemies vs LOCKED doors (designer 2026-11-22: enemies do all the operatives' door actions). An enemy whose path (cut short: partial) ends within detect_cm of a locked doorway with its goal behind it - or, when the partial path stops elsewhere (a storey below the goal), a locked door at the goal's level within goal_door_cm of the goal, the goal behind it - breaches the door with its archetype's actions in this ESCALATION order: key (a key it carries: Codex/level data GiveKeyToPawn), shoot (a hostile operative's lock burst, lock_shot_chance of his weapon, up to lock_shots bursts), kick (kick_chance_*, up to kick_max_attempts, the noise, his injury rule), blast (a grenade thrown from blast_stand_cm, out of its own blast). Then it walks on to its goal. Ran out of actions = it leaves that door alone for give_up_s. pmc = the hostile operatives (the operative's own door work + clips); monsters bash in place (no clips) - shoot / blast are operative-only. An archetype not listed uses default. Rolls are deterministic: roll_seed (console Codex.Doors.Seed, -DoorSeed=) + door + pawn + attempt.
